# Design Documentation Index

This index is the map for the built-in Wakeflow Design surface.

## Stable Rules

| Type | Document | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Operating policy | [design-window-operating-policy.md](design-window-operating-policy.md) | Defines Design ownership, boundaries, and handoff contract. |
| Workspace alignment checklist | [workspace-alignment-checklist.md](workspace-alignment-checklist.md) | Checks whether a design draft is ready for controller intake. |

## Current Work

| Type | Document | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Current area | [current/README.md](current/README.md) | Explains where active plans, designs, signals, and handoff drafts live. |
| Handoff board | [current/workspace-handoff-board.md](current/workspace-handoff-board.md) | Local Design board for completed design handoffs. |

## Templates

| Template | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [../templates/original-plan-template.md](../templates/original-plan-template.md) | First-pass demand framing before confirmation. |
| [../templates/requirement-design-template.md](../templates/requirement-design-template.md) | Detailed requirement design after confirmation. |
| [../templates/workspace-signal-template.md](../templates/workspace-signal-template.md) | Lightweight bug, TODO, research, decision, or blocker signal. |
| [../templates/workspace-handoff-template.md](../templates/workspace-handoff-template.md) | Formal handoff draft for controller intake. |

Use lowercase kebab-case filenames and `YYYY-MM-DD` dates for new documents.
